fableRuling.spotCheck: Re-read all 69 originals in 2026-07-01..2026-10-12 from text only: each of the verifier's 10 FFXIV calls is in the caption, and no caption, alt text, tag or quoted post names another franchise (alt text and tags are empty on every post). The tank/healer/DPS-check posts are MMO-generic and rightly left unclear, and collab credits to FFXIV-named artists are rightly not subject evidence; with other = 0 the share stays 100% even if the generic job calls and the memory-identified boss names are dropped.
fableRuling.countInTally: Counted as focused, with a flag: text-only grade (images not inspected by constraint), 10 of 69 captions identifiable; the 2.3% keyword share is a term-list miss, since the captions use lore vocabulary with no hashtags or alt text.
fableRuling.reason: The grading rule leaves out posts with nothing to classify, so the share over classifiable posts is 10/10. The only evidence that could lower the grade is a post identifying a non-FFXIV subject, and there is none in 69 originals; the bio names FFXIV and the keyword-classified reposts are FFXIV-only. Recording unresolved would drop an account whose direction the text settles, and a conservative mostly or partly would be a number derived from nothing; the thin basis belongs in the note, not the grade.
